data.title: House Committee to Consider Crypto Tax Bill Exempting Fees of $10 or Less
data.description:
The House Ways and Means Committee will consider legislation that would exempt qualifying crypto network or transaction fees of $10 or less from capital-gains calculations. According to NS3.AI, the markup is scheduled for Wednesday at 10 a.m. Eastern on Sept. 16.

The bill would also set tax rules for stablecoins, staking, mining and digital asset trading. It still needs to pass Congress and receive the President's approval before it can become law.

data.title: Amazon Unable to Restore Some Data After Persian Gulf Facility Damage
data.description: Amazon.com Inc. has been unable to restore access to some data stored at Persian Gulf facilities damaged during the US-Iran war, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Anthropic Says It Was Profitable For A Second Straight Quarter
data.description: Anthropic told investors it was profitable for a second straight quarter, though the figure excludes the cost of building the next version of Claude, according to BeInCrypto, citing the Financial Times. The company also said adjusted operating income was positive again and gross margins topped 80%, but those margins exclude Amazon’s cut and model-training costs. Revenue reached $11.5 billion in the second quarter, 14 times a year earlier, as markets await Anthropic’s planned Nasdaq listing.

data.title: DoubleLine Capital's Jeffrey Sherman Says the Fed Needs to Raise Rates
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, DoubleLine Capital Deputy Chief Investment Officer Jeffrey Sherman said the Federal Reserve needs to raise rates to convince traders it is committed to lowering inflation and ease market concerns that pushed 10-year U.S. Treasury yields above 5% this week. Sherman said Fed Governor Kevin Warsh has the ability to help by raising rates as soon as tomorrow, and added that the market is already pricing in a rate hike.

data.title: Iran's Foreign Minister Araghchi Says Claims That Iran Is Defenseless Are False
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said claims that Iran is defenseless are false, adding that U.S. Defense Department messages said hundreds of U.S. military facilities were blown to pieces and dozens of military aircraft were burned, and that this was only the tip of the iceberg.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Radiant World, Sapphire Minmetals Sue Glencore in Singapore for $2 Billion
data.description: Radiant World and Sapphire Minmetals have filed a lawsuit against Glencore Plc in Singapore seeking $2 billion in damages, according to a senior executive at the group of companies, Bloomberg reported.

data.title: Bond Traders Price In Fed Rate Hike on Wednesday
data.description: Bond traders are pricing in a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike on Wednesday with a level of conviction that has proven right for decades, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Brookfield Nears Center Parcs Recapitalization at $6 Billion Valuation
data.description: Brookfield is nearing a recapitalization of Center Parcs in a deal that values the British holiday park operator at about $6 billion, people familiar with the matter said, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: STOCKS | RBC Capital Markets Upgrades ResMed to Outperform
data.description:
ResMed shares rose nearly 5% on Tuesday after RBC Capital Markets upgraded the medical device and digital health company from Sector Perform to Outperform. According to Sina Finance, the firm also raised its price target to $262 from $244, implying 17% upside from the current share price of $229.

RBC Capital Markets cited ResMed's improving earnings outlook and stronger capital management as the main reasons for the upgrade. The firm said ResMed could deliver high-single-digit earnings growth over the next several years.

data.title: UK Fiscal Watchdog to Issue One Forecast Before Budget
data.description:
Britain’s fiscal watchdog will publish just one economic forecast before the Treasury sets budget policy, according to a person familiar with the matter.

The change is intended to make the process more predictable and give the Chancellor of the Exchequer more time to prepare, Bloomberg reported.

data.title: U.S. Treasury Says Bond Buyback Intervention Was Successful, Discusses AI Liability and Japan Intervention
data.description:
The U.S. Treasury said its bond buyback intervention was successful and that a funding offset plan for $5,000 checks is moving forward. According to Odaily, it also said it would meet House Speaker Johnson if congressional authorization is clearly needed, and urged lawmakers not to exempt artificial intelligence companies from liability.

The Treasury said AI policy must address both innovation and safety, and that companies should not receive a blank check on liability. It also said it is engaged in ongoing discussions about Japan intervention, used a notional amount in yen intervention, and earned tens of millions of dollars from that intervention. The Treasury added that it previously earned tens of millions of dollars from aid provided to Argentina.

data.title: Saudi Aramco Reportedly Delays Oil Supplies to Some European Customers After Pipeline Attack
data.description: According to Sina Finance, people familiar with the matter said Saudi Aramco is delaying oil supplies to some European customers this month. The disruption follows the closure of a key Saudi oil export pipeline after a drone attack a few days earlier. It is not yet clear how long the long-term contract cargoes will be delayed.

data.title: Glencore Accuses Radiant World of Falsified Invoices to Lenders
data.description:
Glencore Plc accused iron ore trader Radiant World of sending falsified invoices to a number of financial institutions, according to Bloomberg.

The allegation is the latest in a series of fraud claims against Radiant World.

data.title: Peru Economy Rebounds in July, Beating Forecasts
data.description: Peru’s economy rebounded in July on strong performance across most sectors, according to Bloomberg. Unusually warmer weather weighed on fishing, agriculture and related industries.

data.title: Kiyosaki Says Biggest Stock And Bond Market Crash Has Started
data.description: Robert Kiyosaki, author of Rich Dad Poor Dad, said the biggest stock and bond market crash in history has already begun and is spreading from Europe and Japan worldwide. According to BeInCrypto, he linked the warning to his 2002 book Rich Dad’s Prophecy, cited AI speculation, Iran tensions, record global debt and Baby Boomer retirements, and urged holders of 401(k)s and IRAs, especially those over 40, to prepare with gold, silver, Bitcoin and other hard assets.

data.title: Binance Wallet Launches Al Ain vs. Al Nassr Prediction Market and PnL Trading Competition
data.description:
Binance Wallet announced on X that the Al Ain vs. Al Nassr Prediction Market is now live as the Asian Football League returns. The announcement said Al Ain will host the side it knocked out last season, and asked whether Al Nassr can turn the tables. The post did not provide additional match details beyond the live prediction market update.

Binance Wallet also said users can join the PnL Trading Competition for a share of a 100,000 USDT prize pool. No further terms, eligibility details, or competition rules were included in the announcement. The post presented both the prediction market and the trading competition as part of the same update, with the competition tied to the live football market.

data.title: Bessent Says U.S. Has Stayed in Contact on Japan’s Yen Intervention
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent said the U.S. has remained in contact regarding Japan’s intervention in the yen exchange rate, that the U.S. used a "notional amount" for the yen intervention, and that the U.S. received at least tens of millions of dollars in profit from it.

data.title: STOCKS | Stocks Slip Before Fed Decision as Yields Remain Elevated
data.description:
Wall Street traders held back from riskier bets ahead of the Federal Reserve decision, with stocks falling as elevated oil prices kept bond yields at multi-year highs, according to Bloomberg.

Victoria Fernandez, chief market strategist at Crossmark Global Investments, discussed equity bullishness amid a deepening bond selloff.

data.title: Truist Agrees to Sell $5.5 Billion Auto Loan Portfolio to Apollo
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, Truist Financial agreed to sell $5.5 billion of auto loans to Apollo Global Management, a deal expected to generate $5.2 billion in net proceeds and release $535 million in loan-loss reserves while allowing Truist to exit the business of making car loans to subprime consumers. Truist is conducting a broader strategic review under new CEO Mike Lyons, who is seeking to improve the bank's business mix and narrow its strategic focus to core areas.

data.title: STOCKS | Erebor Bank’s Stablecoin Perk Backfires Into Losses
data.description:
Erebor Bank was forced to end a free stablecoin-to-cash service after professional crypto trading firms exploited the policy for arbitrage. According to Sina Finance, the losses were borne entirely by Erebor Bank.

The bank had launched the perk when it officially opened earlier this year to attract crypto customers, offering to convert stablecoins into cash at face value with no fee. According to Sina Finance, market prices for stablecoins often trade slightly below $1, creating an arbitrage opportunity for firms that buy discounted tokens and redeem them at Erebor for full value.

Wintermute and Galaxy Digital were among the firms that took part in the redemption arbitrage, according to people familiar with the matter. Erebor later notified institutions including Wintermute to stop such trades and ended the free conversion benefit for customers without large deposits.

The bank is also preparing to complete a $1.5 billion funding round at an $8 billion post-money valuation. It received a national banking charter from the U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency in February, becoming the first new bank approved during U.S. President Donald Trump's second administration.
